name: Meguru Kisetsu no Yakusoku to, Tsunaida Sono Te no Nukumori to
original_name: めぐる季節の約束と、つないだその手のぬくもりと
source:
Akira can't remember anything from his childhood, however it doesn't bother him since he still enjoys a relatively normal life. One day, he was led to an abandoned amusement park by a cat, and he had a vision of many people there, coupled with hearing the noises of the crowds. His forgotten feelings, wishes and memories… To fulfill the promise from that day long long ago, Akira's frozen clock had once again begin to move.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

The game was cancelled after many delays in June 2015, and thus, only the trial was released.
translation:
明不记得童年的任何事情，但这并没有困扰他，因为他依然过着相对正常的生活。某天，一只猫将他引到了一座废弃的游乐园，他幻视到那里有很多人，还听到了人群的喧闹声。他遗忘的情感、心愿和记忆……为了实现很久很久以前那天的约定，明停滞的时钟再次开始转动。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

该游戏在多次延期后于2015年6月被取消，因此只有试玩版被发布。
